errors.evidence: The second data series is not a line with a dotted style, but a series of discrete circular markers (effectively a scatter plot).

errors.text_span: Плътната линия започва приблизително на 13 000 лева през 2018 година
errors.evidence: The solid line begins at approximately 13,800 leva in 2018, not 13,000. The stated value is a significant underestimation.

errors.text_span: След това линията остава относително стабилна до около 2020 година
errors.evidence: The plateau of the solid line at approximately 15,000 leva extends from mid-2019 until the beginning of 2021. The description incorrectly states that it ends around 2020, misrepresenting the duration of this feature by about a year.
The solid line ends at a value of approximately 22,500 leva in 2022, not 23,000.

errors.text_span: Пунктираната линия с маркери също започва от около 13 000 лева през 2018 година
errors.evidence: The first data point of the series with markers is at approximately 12,500 leva in 2018, not 13,000.
